design: Ridge encoder on normalized activation or frozen64 bilinear codes predicts differences of H958 budget1 shared consistent state coordinates. Fixed outputspan .1/top8 bothseeds. Seven complete noun-family folds, each withholding both templates; separate two-way template transfer. Scalar training-edge RMS normalization and alpha .001 fixed before evaluation. Original encoder and teacher-informed state oracle as controls. All per-fold predictions replayed live on isolated MLP and joint paths.
limits: Coefficient supervision derives from teacher outputs. Not unsupervised discovery. Only seven source nouns and two templates; this repeatedly examined development panel is not a pristine confirmation set. No heldout teacher coefficients/norms enter predictions; holdout means the current encoder training split, not pretraining.
